layout_amendment: Shorter repeated axis labels only; fixed data, scales, windows, templates and all numeric outputs unchanged. White line is the inherited trace; true cross-dispersion offset is native column minus that trace, not minus its rounded value. Raw row offsets are relative to each window center.
pixel_interpolation: none in displays; nearest native image pixels
residual_scale: symmetric maximum absolute residual across all measured windows and all templates
raw_model_scale: shared native min/max per displayed window; differs between windows
